comment: Narrow waiver list for the transition-event attestation checker (bin/check_transition_attestation.py). Per architect ruling 6b42dd3f-ae62-4abf-8cce-fdc01c41032e (record + AAR thread comment a6c7f5f5-f9bf-4cbe-8361-4d68cdf256ec): these enumerated historical rows are attested by their row-level closure evidence instead of a kernel.transition_event, because their closure predates the emission fix (PR #560) on the TS receipt-advance path. This list is the ONLY suppression surface: it must never grow except by an explicit architect ruling recorded here, and it never suppresses future rows. No transition_event rows were synthesized for any of these tickets. Cohort `wb3_pre_fix_expired_generation` (W-B3, plan 8261675) is carried under architect ruling ea38297d-1f4e-4cc5-8cda-ef8273702bf8: this decision record is the authority for that growth. It covers exactly the 89 enumerated `expired` generations with no `expiry_detection` event and `expires_at` in 2026-06-18T00:00:00Z..2026-07-27T00:00:00Z (exclusive end), all predating the PR #560 emission fix. The cohort is closed: no row created after the fix is admitted, and no transition_event was synthesized for any of them. The two 6b42dd3f rows above remain the only rows under that older ruling.
